title: Agent Output Schema
description: The agent shall return its output in this schema. This allows passing information back on the quality of the input and re-route the ticket in case of insufficient input

status.description: Whether the current phase may proceed. Use success only when no further work is required for this phase. Use blocked whenever clarification or remediation is required, including code-review findings that require changes.

neededClarifications.description: Clarifications or remediation items required when status is 'blocked'; otherwise an empty array

name.description: The name of the output file

content.description: The content of the file, either text or binary base64 coded

contentType.description: Define the content type of the property 'content'. If 'binary', then content is the base64 encoded value of binary content
